local_17_6_proof.note: Chief local docker postgres:17.6 via host psql 17.11; LF-only framing

mid_sequence_note: Per-step poisonFingerprintEval.ok=true for all six; durable original stdout/stderr sha preserved for final probe and local proof (qualify evidence stores final probe raw).

argv:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'schema_version', 'f3-poison-envelope-v1',
  'poisonPresent', (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_trigger t
      JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
      JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
      WHERE t.tgname = 'trg_f3_dbpush_fail_target_history'
        AND n.nspname = 'supabase_migrations'
        AND NOT t.tgisinternal
    )
    OR to_regprocedure('supabase_migrations.f3_dbpush_fail_target_history()') IS NOT NULL
  ),
  'current_database', current_database(),
  'current_user', current_user,
  'probe_marker', 'f3_poison_absent_probe'
)::text;
